name: Billings

neighborhoods.name: North Elevation
neighborhoods.homes: older houses and small apartment buildings

housing: Billings' rentals are mostly single-family houses and apartment complexes, with older homes near downtown and newer ones on the West End and in the Heights.
climate: Test the furnace, check windows for drafts and photograph the roof and siding for hail damage; winters are cold and windy.
fact: Billings is the largest city in Montana.
